description: Golden test vectors for App Attest inspection

testVectors.name: Normal Assertion
testVectors.description: Standard assertion with 37-byte authenticatorData (minimal assertion shape)
testVectors.note: This is the minimal assertion structure: rpIdHash(32) + flags(1) + signCount(4)

testVectors.name: AT Flag Inconsistent Assertion
testVectors.description: Assertion with AT flag set but no attestedCredentialData payload (37 bytes)
testVectors.expectedWarning: AT flag set but attested credential data not present
testVectors.note: This tests the flag vs length sanity check. Length is authoritative.

testVectors.name: Missing clientDataHash
testVectors.note: Virtual COSE payload will be incomplete without clientDataHash

testVectors.name: Complete Context
testVectors.description: Assertion with all required context (keyID, clientDataHash, publicKey)

usage: These are reference cases for testing inspection behavior. Actual test vectors would contain Base64-encoded assertion objects.
